parameters.name: Executions
parameters.description: The list of execution plans to be added for the scheduled prefetch task.

sub_parameters.name: EndTime
sub_parameters.description: The end time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z).

sub_parameters.name: Interval
sub_parameters.description: The interval between each batch execution of the scheduled prefetch plan, in seconds.

sub_parameters.name: SliceLen
sub_parameters.description: The number of URLs to prefetch per batch.

sub_parameters.name: StartTime
sub_parameters.description: The start time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z).

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The prefetch task ID, generated by calling the [CreateScheduledPreloadJob](~~2850459~~) operation.
